question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH all_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events
),
purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events 
    WHERE event_type = 3 AND page_id = 13
),
non_purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT visit_id FROM all_visits WHERE visit_id NOT IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits)
)
SELECT 
    CAST(p.product_id AS INTEGER) as product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as view_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as add_to_cart_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 AND e.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM non_purchase_visits) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as left_in_cart_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 AND e.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as purchase_count
FROM shopping_cart_events e
JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY product_id

args.sql:
WITH all_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events
),
purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events 
    WHERE event_type = 3 AND page_id = 13
),
non_purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT visit_id FROM all_visits WHERE visit_id NOT IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits)
)
SELECT 
    CAST(p.product_id AS INTEGER) as product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as view_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as add_to_cart_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 AND e.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM non_purchase_visits) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as left_in_cart_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 AND e.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as purchase_count
FROM shopping_cart_events e
JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
WHERE e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
GROUP BY p.product_id
ORDER BY product_id
